name: Get Your Game On!
ability: You can only play this card if you were present at the 2007 Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME World Championship. The ATK of all your "Elemental Hero" and "Neo-Spacian" monsters on the field is doubled.

name: Chimaera, the Master of Beasts
ability: This card cannot be Special Summoned. To Tribute Summon this card, you must Tribute 3 Beast-Type monsters. If this card attacks your opponent directly and reduces their Life Points to 0, you win the Match.

name: Emperor of Lightning
ability: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card must be Tribute Summoned by Tributing 3 Thunder-Type monsters on your side of the field. If this card attacks your opponent's Life Points directly and makes them 0, the controller of this card wins the Match.
